what.value: One read-only surface unifying cron, systemd, cyder and clicks into a single legible clock of the system's time-drivers, plus a click-counted turn-trigger mechanism.
what.quote: The Arxana Clock is the single surface that answers, at a glance: *what keeps this system ticking, when did each last fire, and when does it fire next?*
